options.name: application_pool
options.description: The application pool in which the new site executes. If not specified, the application pool of the current website will be used.

options.name: connect_as
options.description: The type of authentication to use for this application. Either C(pass_through) or C(specific_user) If C(pass_through), IIS will use the identity of the user or application pool identity to access the file system or network. If C(specific_user), IIS will use the credentials provided in I(username) and I(password) to access the file system or network.

options.name: password
options.description: The password associated with I(username). Required when I(connect_as) is set to C(specific_user).

options.name: physical_path
options.description: The physical path on the remote host to use for the new application. The specified folder must already exist.

options.name: site
options.description: Name of the site on which the application is created.

options.name: username
options.description: Specifies the user name of an account that can access configuration files and content for this application. Required when I(connect_as) is set to C(specific_user).
